column1: # Offline relevance fixture for `--rag-learn`.
# Hand-authored, NOT judge output. It exists so the learning-to-rank mode has a label source
# when the local `--rag-eval` judge cache is absent; when that cache exists it is the default,
# because it is graded against the corpus as actually retrieved rather than against doc topics.
# Format:  query <TAB> document-path <TAB> grade   (grade 2 = answers the query, 1 = related, 0 = not relevant)
# IDs are document paths, not `path#chunk` ids: chunk ordinals move whenever a document is edited,
# which is exactly how the judge cache went stale, while document paths survive. Every chunk of a
# matched document inherits its grade.
# Paths resolve against the corpus NivaraChat indexes: `<docs-dir>/**/*.md` plus
# `samples/NivaraChat/README.md`. Lines beginning with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
